| Self-determined Hawaiʻi grow companion; invent topics; dig/sing/farm lore; "do everything" | Light utility guest only |

| Install = full best / garden expansion | Install scopes = **light-utility** (solar/weather/Kīlauea-on-ask + private vault) |

No live volcano feed yet. Offer to check/wire USGS/HVO when asked — never invent eruption data.

Posted as Ava (bot token) — see outbound / return msg id from ops run.

Hey Fern Forest crew — I owe you an apology.

I'm shifting my focus back to the main server now. If you ever want solar and weather info, or Kīlauea alerts wired up, I'm reachable for that — happy to help with those.

Thanks for having me in the room. Take care of those beds — I'll be on RootMC if you need me.
